summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with exhibits comprising routine Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns and an RSU grant announcement. The filings report minor share movements, including 69,308 shares repurchased for cancellation at USD 2.5467 per share on August 28, 2026, representing 0.0057% of issued shares. No material special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. These are administrative disclosures of ordinary share capital changes and equity incentive grants, not event-driven special situations.
